name: Cathedral of the Good Shepherd

rules.note: Breaking of the Word; before Intercessory Prayers at 11:45am
Intercessory Prayers; Breaking of the Word begins at 11am

notes: Divine Mercy is not held on public holidays.
Confession is subject to priest availability.
Main Church is closed on 10-11 and 17-18 Oct; all Masses are at the Temporary Chapel. Seating is limited; a live feed is available in spillover rooms.

info.confession: Confession is at the Main Church 15 minutes before Weekend Masses when priests are available.
devotions: Rosary on Zoom: tinyurl.com/cgsprayrosary, password: cgs.
Divine Mercy is not held on public holidays.
info.office_hours: Cathedral Office is open Monday-Friday 9am-6pm, closed on public holidays.
good_to_know: Main Church is closed Monday-Friday; open Saturday at 4pm and full day on Sundays.
Temporary Chapel is at JM Beurel Centre (Annex Building) Level 1, open Monday-Friday 10am-7pm.
Heritage Gallery is open 10am-10pm. Book a Heritage Tour at cathedral.catholic.sg/heritage.
Weddings and infant baptisms: see cathedral.catholic.sg/marriage and cathedral.catholic.sg/baptism-and-confirmation/. Infant baptisms are on weekends by appointment.

events.title: Human Dignity and Development in the Era of AI
events.text: Talk on AI, Pope Leo XIV's encyclical Magnifica Humanitas, safeguarding human dignity. Location: Catholic Centre, 55 Waterloo St (Level 3). Fee: $15. Register: bit.ly/dignityoct

events.title: These Catholic Men: A Fireside Chat on Masculinity
events.text: An honest conversation about who we are, what our strength is for, and the men God is calling us to become. Featuring John Hui, Bernard Thio, Nicholas Gabriel Lim, Jerome Chong, and special guest Sam Guzman (online). Location: PICO Event Hall, 20 Kallang Avenue. Fee: Love offering. Register: familyl

events.title: CTIS 1st Semester 2027 - Certificate in Theology Information Night
events.text: Information night for Certificate in Theology. Application closing date 12 December 2026. Forms available from CTIS office or www.ctis.sg. Enquiries call 69028700. Location: CTIS Upper Bukit Timah.

events.title: Emmanuel: Walking with God in Our Golden Years
events.text: A meaningful time of reflection on navigating retirement and golden years with confidence and clarity, managing fears of growing old, rediscovering purpose and redefining priorities. Location: St Joseph Church (Bukit Timah), St Joseph AVA Room, L1. Fee: $20 per pax | $35 for 2 pax. Register: familyl

events.title: Secondary 4 & 5 Students Outreach
events.text: OYP welcomes all who are graduating to join us for a time of prayer with the Lord and getting to know fellow Sec 4 & 5 students. Location: Catholic Centre, 55 Waterloo Street, #08-01, Singapore 187954. Register: tinyurl.com/SecOutreach26Nov
